d:
Love is the most powerful force in the whole creation.
Love enlightens us about oneness. It teaches us selfless work, doing things for others.
We do it for love.
Its the most powerful feeling as well.
We feel blissful when we are in love.
Imagine falling in love with everything
Everything become us.
I wish we could all experience that nondual nature of our collective existence everyday but Love does not come to us so easily.
